text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously! Winning the inter-class 
multi-sport relay at the last Fan 
Appreciation Festival felt sooooo good, 
didn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You're bringing that up again?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it as many times as I want! Even 
you were smiling a tiny bit when we 
crossed the finish line in 1st place in 
the three-person-four-legged race, 
Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No I wasn't...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. While our team play certainly 
contributed to the class's victory—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that regard, the one who demonstrated 
the greatest effort was undoubtedly our 
class rep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh! M-Me? But wait, I didn't even run in 
the multi-sport relay...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if you did not participate on the 
track, did you not manage all sorts of 
things behind the scenes so our uniquely 
eccentric classmates could perform at 
their very best?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, all that's left is the 
three-person-four-legged race! Everyone, 
let's cheer on BNW with all our might! 
Ready, set...!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Our class's splendid triumph was only 
possible thanks to your presence, 
tirelessly working behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, exactly! I really think we're 
such a fun, close-knit, amazing class all 
because of you, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Always... You're always, always... 
*sniff*, all the tiiiime...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*WAAAAHHH*! Thank you so much for 
everything! Keep looking out for us, Class 
Reeeeep~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! It's me who should be thanking 
all of you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that makes me so... so, so 
very happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my all! I'll do everything 
I can, even more than ever!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you don't have to get that worked 
up over it...

One day, I spotted Narita Top Road 
carrying a heavy-looking box—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*phew*... Alright! I just need to carry 
this to the training room, right!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's right, but... Are you really 
sure you can handle it by yourself? It's 
filled with weight training gear, so it 
must be quite heavy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll be totally fine! Please leave it to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My classmates mentioned wanting to use the 
new equipment as soon as possible... So I 
want to deliver it to them right away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, here I go! Heave-ho...!!
choice_data_list:
You really should get someone to help 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, here I go! Heave-ho...!!
choice_data_list:
You really should get someone to help 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no, no! This is really, truly 
heavy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm saying it precisely because it's 
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Wait, Ayabe-san!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm of the same opinion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Wait, Ayabe-san!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, I figured as much. Ayabe, put 
that down for a sec and take some stuff 
out. I'll carry some too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Me too, me too!! I'll help out, Top Road!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ev-everyone... Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'why'?! Isn't it 
obvious?! It's just like how it was during 
the relay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You always give your all for everyone 
else! So that makes us want to give our 
all for your sake too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In other words! You don't have to carry 
everything all by yourself, Class 
Repーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much. Yeah... Please, lend 
me a hand!
